scope: Local mocked settings lifecycle and profile acceptance regression

environment.temporaryRoot: Workspace-local process TEMP/TMP; Pester TestDrive remained isolated

diagnosis: The earlier 36 failures came from File.Move being denied in the system-temp location used by Pester TestDrive under the restricted sandbox. A direct probe reproduced the denial in system TEMP and succeeded under the writable repository. Re-running with process-scoped TEMP/TMP rooted under the repository passed all tests; no product code change was required.
